name: Multi-resolution grids
aliases: Hierarchical Grid Traversal > Multi-level Grid Structures > Multi-resolution grids
definition: A recursive hierarchical subdivision algorithm for grids proposed by Jevans and Wyvill [JW89] that integrates regular and adaptive spatial subdivision methods.
summary: Multi-resolution grids are recursive hierarchical subdivision algorithms that efficiently render mixed-scale scenes by testing each nested grid along a ray path exactly once.
